dedup_rule: Identical SHA-256 is auto-collapsible only when metadata corroborates identity through the same normalised title or canonical URL. Repeated hashes across unrelated titles/URLs are treated as extraction collisions requiring text recovery. Same-title/year and same-URL clusters remain review-only unless safely resolved.
